name: print-social-doodle-shapes-resume-cover-on-crumpled-paper
title: Resume cover with hand-drawn colourful shapes on crumpled white paper
whatItIs: A crumpled white paper spread with a heavy hand-lettered 'GRAPHIC DESIGNER RESUME' in dark ink in the middle and a scatter of colourful hand-drawn stars, bursts, squiggles, flowers and asterisks in blue, purple, orange, pink, yellow and green. A name tape strip overlaps the title.
whatItMeans: Warm, playful and human; imperfect marks feel drawn by hand.
techniques: Scatter a vocabulary of hand-drawn shapes around a central title.
Use crumpled paper texture as the ground.
Keep each shape in one flat colour with a crayon-like edge.
Attach a black tape strip label with handwriting.

vocabulary.definition: A set of hand-drawn marks used as decoration.
A photo of wrinkled paper used as a background.
A slightly rough outline like wax crayon.
A tape strip carrying a name.
